coordinateSystem: Native full-sheet PNG x,y, no resize/flip. frame is local action-group index; sourcePoseIndex is zero-based whole sheet index. Marks sampled on actual native muzzle opening.

flamethrower.note: Visible open end interior of original-style flamethrower muzzle, not hand, backpack or imaginary orb. Shoot/super share same native muzzle. Floor deployment mark documents real nozzle; engine floor trap collision placement remains root-owned and must not be silently changed.
